game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time

author: ReviewAtex
quote: Eh, it's alright. I would rate the game a little higher if it wasn't for the price, I paid $100 for this game, ouch, and for the INSANE amount of hype, but not much higher. The gameplay is pretty generic and doesn't excite me all too much, I didn't feel I got anything from the game that I haven't gotten from other games, sure it's fun to steal cars drive around and play some missions, but that's any GTA game, and the missions and story here from what I have played so far are not super exciting in my opinion, but I guess I should have expected this since I was never a huge GTA fan to begin with. If you love these kinds of games, it has the classic GTA mechanics with beautiful graphics and a new story, if you don't play these kind of games very often and you think it may be worth trying because of the hype and how good people say it is, you may be disappointed.
